title: UE is using 5GS services with control plane CIoT 5GS optimization

entities.name: Control Plane Service Request procedure
entities.description: Procedure where UE sends CONTROL PLANE SERVICE REQUEST message to initiate services using control plane CIoT 5GS optimization.

entities.name: CONTROL PLANE SERVICE REQUEST
entities.description: NAS message sent by UE to request control plane services in 5GS with CIoT optimization.

entities.name: Control plane service type
entities.description: IE indicating the type of service request: mobile terminating request, mobile originating request, emergency services, emergency services fallback, or mobile terminated services.

entities.name: CIoT small data container
entities.description: Container for small data transmission in CIoT, containing Data type field, PDU session ID, data, and Downlink data expected (DDX).

entities.name: Payload container
entities.description: Container for larger data payloads when data size exceeds 254 octets or optional IEs are included.

entities.name: Uplink data status
entities.description: IE indicating which PDU session(s) have pending user data to be sent via user-plane resources.

entities.name: Allowed PDU session status
entities.description: IE included when paging request includes non-3GPP access type indication and UE has PDU sessions not associated with control plane only.

entities.name: Paging restriction
entities.description: Optional IE for UE to include paging restriction preferences.

entities.name: UE request type
entities.description: IE containing Request type field values like 'NAS signalling connection release' or 'Rejection of paging'.

entities.name: T3517
entities.description: Timer started when UE sends CONTROL PLANE SERVICE REQUEST message.

entities.name: 5GMM-SERVICE-REQUEST-INITIATED
entities.description: State entered by UE after sending CONTROL PLANE SERVICE REQUEST message.

entities.name: Data size not more than 254 octets
entities.description: Condition where data size is ≤254 octets and no other optional IEs to include.

entities.name: Data size more than 254 octets
entities.description: Condition where data size >254 octets or other optional IEs to include.

relations.description: Procedure involves sending CONTROL PLANE SERVICE REQUEST message.
Procedure causes UE to enter 5GMM-SERVICE-REQUEST-INITIATED state.
Message contains Control plane service type IE.
Message may contain CIoT small data container IE for small data.
Message may contain Payload container IE for larger data.
Message may contain Uplink data status IE for user-plane data indication.
Message may contain Allowed PDU session status IE under specific conditions.
Message may optionally contain Paging restriction IE.
Message may contain UE request type IE for specific request types.
Condition determines use of CIoT small data container IE.
Condition determines use of Payload container IE.
